column1: # Gate thresholds for the native UI rebuild (docs/design/native-ui-rebuild/GOLDEN-STANDARD.md §9). Lead-only file.
# box_pct: differing pixels inside the shot's ink box (union of the Flutter and native ink, padded 4 px), in percent.
# blob_px: the largest 8-connected cluster of differing pixels after one 3x3 erosion (anti-aliasing and 1-2 px glyph
# shifts erode away; a wrong, missing or moved element does not). A shot passes when both are at or under the tier's
# numbers and the native frame has the Flutter frame's size.
